oromo: Qondaaltoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin Palastinoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru akkasumas qabeenyisaanii manca'eera. Miidhaan kun reebicha, manneenii fi konkolaataalee mancaasuu, akkasumas lafa qonnaa irratti miidhaa geessisuu kan dabalatuudha. Gabaasoonni akka agarsiisutti, haleellaan kun yeroo baay'ee humnoota nageenyaa Israa'el jalatti kan raawwatamuudha.

title: Iran and Oman defining a temporary route for now, Araghchi says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi clarified that current discussions with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are strictly technical and focused on establishing new maritime routes. He emphasized that these logistical talks are independent of the broader political decision to fully reopen the waterway. Whether the Strait eventually reopens remains contingent upon the United States meeting specific external conditions.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ከኦማን ጋር እየተደረገ ያለው ድርድር የሆርሙዝ ባህርን የመርከብ መስመር የመለየት ቴክኒካዊ ጉዳይ ብቻ እንደሆነ ገለጹ። ይህ ውይይት የባህር መስመሩን ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመክፈት የፖለቲካ ውሳኔ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስታውቀዋል። የሆርሙዝ ባህር መከፈት በዋነኝነት የተመካው አሜሪካ በሌሎች ስምምነቶች ላይ የገባችውን ቃል መፈጸም አለመፈጸም ላይ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, mariin Oomaan waliin taasifamaa jiru karaa markaboota galaana Hormuz keessa darban qindeessuuf kan gargaaru dhimma teeknikaa qofa akka ta'e ibsan. Mariin kun guutummaatti karaa galaanichaa banuuf murtoo siyaasaa irra jiru waliin walitti hidhata akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Dhimmi karaa galaana Hormuz banuu fi banuu dhabuu isaa kan murtaa'u, Ameerikaan haala biroo irratti galte tokko tokko yoo guutte qofa akka ta'e himaniiru.

title: Al Jazeera journalist opens beach cafe in the Gaza she loves
english: Hind Khoudary, a journalist for Al Jazeera, has launched a new beach cafe in Gaza as a way to reclaim a sense of normalcy amidst the ongoing conflict. She created this space to provide a safe environment where local residents can connect and find a moment of peace during difficult times. Through this initiative, she aims to preserve a cherished aspect of Gazan life despite the surrounding devastation.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ ሂንድ ኩዳሪ በጋዛ ውስጥ አዲስ የባህር ዳርቻ ካፌ ከፍታለች። ይህም በጦርነት ለተጎዳው አካባቢ ነዋሪዎች አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም መገናኛ እና መረጋጋት የሚፈጥርበት ቦታ እንዲሆን ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ጋዜጠኛዋ በዚህ ተግባሯ በጋዛ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ባህል ለማስቀጠል እና ለህዝቡ ትንሽም ብትሆን ሰላማዊ ጊዜ ለመፍጠር ትጥራለች።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Al Jazeera Hind Khoudary, magaalaa Gaazaatti kafee bakka bashannana qarqara galaanaa tokko banatteetti. Kafeen kun, yeroo waraanaafi rakkoo cimaa keessa jiran kanatti, ummanni wal arguufi xiqqoo ta'us tasgabbii argachuuf bakka itti fayyadaman ta'a jedhamee yaadameera. Tarkaanfiin kun, akkaataa jireenyaa durii Gaazaatti beekamu sana rakkoo waraanaafi diiggaa jiru cinaatti akkasumas lubbuun jiraachisuuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Houthis launch sixth ballistic missile at Marib city
english: Houthi forces recently conducted their sixth ballistic missile strike on the Yemeni city of Marib, resulting in significant property damage. These repeated attacks have severely endangered civilians, including those living in refugee camps and residential areas. Previous strikes in the region have already caused multiple injuries and destroyed homes, vehicles, and local businesses.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ማሪብ ከተማ ላይ ስድስተኛውን የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ተደጋጋሚ እየሆነ የመጣው ይህ ጥቃት በከተማዋ ለሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች እና ለተፈናቃዮች ካምፖች ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ከዚህ ቀደም በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን የቤት ንብረቶችና ተሽከርካሪዎችም ወድመዋል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin magaalaa Ma'arib kan Yamanitti xiyyaara kombattuu (ballistic missile) ja'affaa harcaasee jira. Haleellaan deddeebi'ee gaggeeffamaa jiru kun jireenya namoota nagaa fi qubata godaantotaa balaa hamaa irra buusee jira. Haleellaa darban kanaan namootni hedduun miidhamaa fi qabeenyi namoota nagaa kanneen akka manaa fi konkolaataa barbadaa'anii jiru.

title: Explosions heard in Lebanon's Nabatieh as Israel continues strikes
english: Israel conducted new airstrikes in Lebanon's Nabatieh district, causing several explosions near the town of Kfar Reman. These raids occurred shortly after a separate series of attacks killed 11 people, marking the highest casualty count since the recent ceasefire. Tensions in the region remain significantly elevated following these latest military operations.
amharic: እስራኤል በሊባኖስ ናባቲህ ግዛት አዲስ የአየር ጥቃት የፈጸመች ሲሆን በከፋር ሬማን ከተማ አካባቢ በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት 11 ሰዎችን የገደለው ቀደም ሲል ከተካሄደው የአየር ጥቃት በኋላ ነው። ይህ ሁኔታ በቅርቡ ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት የቀጠፈ ክስተት ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: Isiraa'el naannoo Naabaatiyeh kan Libaanoos keessatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa haaraa gaggeessiteen, magaalaa Kfar Reman biratti dhoohiinsi cimaan dhaga'ameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame namoota 11 ajjeese erga haleellaa duraa raawwatamee booda. Kunis walii galtee waraana dhaabuu dhiheenya kana irra ga'amee booda balaa cimaa tasa uumame dha.

title: Opinion: How a pragmatic axis could reshape the Middle East
english: The Middle East is moving beyond its traditional power struggle between Iran's proxy network and the US-backed Israeli security framework. A new influential bloc, referred to as a Sunni axis, is beginning to take shape with leadership from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. This shift suggests that the region's long-standing political dynamics are being fundamentally reorganized into a more complex three-part structure.
amharic: የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ከአሁን በፊት በነበረው የኢራን ተፅዕኖ እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል የደህንነት ማዕቀፍ መካከል የነበረውን ፍጥጫ እያለፈ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የሚመሩት አዲስ የሱኒ ሀገራት ቡድን ብቅ እያለ ነው። ይህ ለውጥ የቀጠናው የረጅም ጊዜ የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ ወደ ውስብስብ የሶስትዮሽ ቅርፅ እየተቀየረ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hala siyaasaa Baha Giddu galeessaa durii kan ture walitti bu'iinsa Iran fi tumsa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el darbee, ammaan tana gara caalaatti jijjiiramaa jira. Gareen biyyoota Sunniin durfamu kan akka Sa'udii Arabiyaa, Turkaayii fi Paakistaan walitti dhufeenyaan hundaa'aa jira. Jijjiiramni kun caasaa siyaasaa naannichaa kan durii sun gara caasaa sadetti kan qoodamee fi caalaatti walxaxaa ta'eetti jijjiiramaa jiraachuu agarsiisa.

title: Prosecutors Charge Seven Alleging Amhara Bank’s Credit Controls Bend for One Borrower
english: Federal prosecutors have filed corruption and abuse of power charges against seven individuals and a private company. The accused include several former high-ranking executives from Amhara Bank and the leadership of Zemera Investment Group. These charges stem from allegations that they illegally bypassed credit regulations in foreign trade deals, resulting in a loss of over 137 million Birr for the bank.
amharic: የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ በአማራ ባንክ ላይ ከ137 ሚሊዮን ብር በላይ የገንዘብ ብክነት አድርሰዋል በሚል ሰባት ግለሰቦችና አንድ የግል ድርጅት ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። በተከሳሽነት የቀረቡት የባንኩ የቀድሞ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የባንኩ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች እና የዜሜራ ኢንቨስትመንት ግሩፕ ኃላፊዎች ናቸው። ተከሳሾቹ በውጭ ንግድ ስምምነቶች ወቅት የብድር መመሪያዎችን በመጣስ ለሙስና እና ለስልጣን ያለአግባብ መጠቀም ተግባር ተጠያቂ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa federaalaa namoota torbaafi dhaabbata dhuunfaa tokko irratti himata malaammaltummaafi aangoo gandaa fayyadamuu dhiyeesseera. Himatamtoota keessatti hooggantoonni olaanoo Baankii Amharaa duraanii fi hooggantoonni dhaabbata 'Zemera Investment Group' kan argaman yoo ta'u, isaanis waliigaltee daldala alaa keessatti seera baankii cabsuun qarshii miliyoona 137 ol baankicharraa akka bade shakkamu.

title: Addis Abeba Builds Over Its Waterways. Now the Floods Find a Way Back
english: Addis Ababa is facing severe flooding issues caused by urban development that has encroached upon natural waterways. The tragedy of an 11-year-old boy who went missing after falling into a hidden, uncovered drain highlights the dangerous consequences of poor city planning. Experts argue that the city's recurrent flooding is not a natural disaster but a direct result of design failures in its infrastructure.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር በተፈጥሯዊ የውሃ መተላለፊያ መንገዶች ላይ ግንባታዎችን ማከናወኑ ለከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ እየዳረገው ይገኛል። በጀሞ አካባቢ የ11 ዓመት ልጅ በጎርፍ ተሸፍኖ በነበረ ክፍት የውሃ ማፍሰሻ ውስጥ ወድቆ መጥፋቱ የከተማዋን ደካማ የመሠረተ ልማት ዝግጅት አጋልጧል። የከተማዋ ጎርፍ በተፈጥሮ የሚከሰት ሳይሆን የተሳሳተ የከተማ ፕላን ውጤት መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Magalaan Finfinnee bakka bishaan gadi ba'uuf uumamanii turan irratti ijaarsa gaggeessuun ishee lolaa hamaaf akka saaxilamtu ishee godheera. Mucaan waggaa 11 tokko iddoo lolaan haguugee ture keessatti bishaan duubatti awwaalame keessatti kufuu isaa fi baduun isaa, rakkoo karoora magaalichaa kan agarsiisuudha. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, lolaan magaalattii keessatti deddeebi'ee mudatu kun balaa uumamaa osoo hin taane, dogoggora ijaarsa magaalichaa irraa kan madde dha.

title: Ethio-post Turns Branches into Banks as Banks Close Theirs
english: Ethio-post is transforming its 3,000 nationwide branches into financial service hubs that allow customers to manage bank accounts, pay bills, and handle cash transactions. Working alongside the ET-switch payment network, the state postal service has already launched a pilot program in 700 locations. This initiative aims to modernize the historic institution by integrating it into the country's formal banking infrastructure within the next month.
amharic: ኢትዮ-ፖስት በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ያሉትን 3,000 ቅርንጫፎቹን የባንክ አገልግሎት መስጫ ማዕከላት ለመቀየር እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ደንበኞች በቅርንጫፎቹ አማካኝነት ገንዘብ ማውጣትና ማስገባት፣ የፍጆታ ክፍያዎችን መፈጸም እንዲሁም የባንክ ሂሳቦቻቸውን ማስተዳደር ይችላሉ። የኢቲ-ስዊች ክፍያ መረብን በመጠቀም በ700 ቅርንጫፎች የሙከራ ስራ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራውን በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ለማስጀመር ታቅዷል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa Poostaan dameewwan isaa 3,000 gara bakka tajaajila baankii kennuutti jijjiiruuf qophaa’aa jira. Tajaajilli kun maamiltoonni maallaqa akka baasan, galchan, kaffaltii tajaajilaa akka raawwatanii fi herreega baankii isaanii akka hogganan kan dandeessisuudha. Walitti hidhamiinsa marsaa kaffaltii 'ET-switch' fayyadamuun dameewwan 700 irratti hojiin qorannoo eegaleera; guyyoota soddoman dhufan keessattis tajaajilli kun guutuu biyyattii keessatti kan eegalu ta'a.

title: Minister Threatens to Blacklist Traders Who Break Export Deals
english: The Ethiopian Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration is implementing strict penalties to address a record number of broken export contracts. Foreign buyers who repeatedly default will be banned from trading with the country for one year, while local exporters face temporary suspension of their permits. Repeat offenders among local businesses will have their trading licenses permanently revoked.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ንግድና ቀጠናዊ ትስስር ሚኒስቴር የወጡ የውጭ ንግድ ውሎችን ባለማክበር የሚፈጸሙ ጥሰቶችን ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደ ነው። እንደ አዲሱ አሰራር፣ በተደጋጋሚ ውል የሚያፈርሱ የውጭ ገዢዎች ለአንድ ዓመት ከኢትዮጵያ ጋር እንዳይገበያዩ ይከለከላሉ። በአገር ውስጥ ያሉ ላኪዎችም የንግድ ፈቃዳቸው ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ታግዶ፣ ተደጋጋሚ ጥሰት በሚፈጽሙት ላይ ግን የንግድ ፈቃዳቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ የመሰረዝ እርምጃ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Ministeerri Daldalaa fi Walitti Hidhamiinsa Naannawaa Itoophiyaa waliigaltee ergaa alaa cabsuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'eera. Gurgurtoota biyya alaa waliigaltee irra deddeebi'anii cabsan irratti waggaa tokkoof daldala irratti hirmaachuu irraa dhorkaan kan jiraatu yoo ta'u, ergaa alaa ergitoota biyya keessaa irrattis hayyamni daldalaa isaanii yeroof ni uggurama. Daldaltoonni biyya keessaa irra deddeebi'anii waliigaltee cabsan hayyama daldalaa isaanii guutummaatti ni dhabu.

title: Supreme Court Widens Shield for Lawyers Fighting the VAT
english: The Federal Supreme Court has extended legal protection to lawyers across several regional states who are challenging a government directive to register for VAT. The court's appellate bench has issued a temporary injunction that prevents the Ministry of Finance from enforcing the tax registration requirement on these attorneys. This stay will remain in place until a final ruling determines whether the government's tax mandate is lawful.
amharic: የፌደራል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ለተጨማሪ የክልል ጠበቆች የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ ምዝገባን ከመፈጸም ነጻ የሚያደርግ ጊዜያዊ እገዳ ሰጥቷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር የወጣውን መመሪያ በመቃወም ላይ ለሚገኙ ጠበቆች የሰጠውን ከለላ ወደ አማራ፣ ሲዳማ፣ ደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ እና ቤኒሻንጉል ጉሙዝ ክልሎች አስፍቷል። ይህ ትእዛዝ መመሪያው ህጋዊነት እስኪረጋገጥ ድረስ ተግባራዊ የሚሆን ይሆናል።
oromo: Mana murtii waliigalaa federaalaa abukaattoota naannolee garaagaraa keessa jiran kanneen dirqama galmee gibira dabalataa (VAT) mormaa jiranaf ittisa seeraa bal'iseera. Mana murtichaa ajaja yeroon abukaattoonni kunneen hanga murtii dhumaa argatutti gibira kaffaluu irraa bilisa akka ta'an murteesseera. Murtiin kun hanga seera qabeessummaan qajeelfama ministeera maallaqaa mirkanaa'utti kan itti fufu ta'a.

title: As petrol prices soar, electric bikes gain ground in Nigeria
english: In Nigeria, the significant rise in petrol prices following the removal of fuel subsidies has led many people to switch to electric motorcycles. While these bikes have a high upfront cost, riders find them much more affordable to operate and maintain than traditional gas-powered vehicles. This transition is also helping to reduce air pollution in urban areas by eliminating harmful exhaust emissions.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ የነዳጅ ድጎማ መነሳቱን ተከትሎ የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ ኤሌክትሪክ ሞተር ሳይክሎች እንዲሸጋገሩ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን የኤሌክትሪክ ሞተር ሳይክሎች የመግዣ ዋጋቸው ከፍተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ተጠቃሚዎች ከነዳጅ እና ከጥገና ወጪ አንጻር ከፍተኛ ቁጠባ እያገኙ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ለውጥ በአካባቢ ብክለት ላይ የሚኖረውን አሉታዊ ተፅዕኖ በመቀነስ ረገድም ፋይዳ አለው።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaa keessatti mootummaan gargaarsa gatii boba’aa waan dhiiseef, gatiin boba’aa ol ka’uun isaa namoonni hedduun gara mootar-sayikilii elektirikiitti akka jijjiiraman taasiseera. Mootar-sayikiliin kun gatii bituu irratti qaalii ta’us, namoonni fayyadaman gatii boba’aa fi suphaa irratti qusannoo guddaa gochuun isaanii ni dubbatu. Jijjiirraan kun faalama qilleensaa hir’isuun naannoo keenya eeguufis gahee guddaa qaba.

title: Army drops roses on Syrian crowds in a far cry from war
english: Syrian military helicopters recently showered flower petals over people attending a festival at the Damascus Citadel. This symbolic gesture marks an effort by the government to restore public cultural activities and promote a sense of normalcy following the conclusion of the civil war. The event highlights a notable shift in atmosphere as the country looks to move past its recent history of intense conflict.
amharic: የሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ሄሊኮፕተሮች በደማስቆ ሲታዴል በተካሄደ የፌስቲቫል ስነስርዓት ላይ ለተገኙ ህዝቦች ጽጌረዳዎችን በትነዋል። ይህ ምልክታዊ ድርጊት መንግስት ከረጅም አመታት የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት በኋላ ባህላዊ ዝግጅቶችን ለማደስ እና ሰላማዊ ሁኔታን ለመፍጠር እያደረገ ያለውን ጥረት ያሳያል። ክስተቱ ሀገሪቱ ካለፈችበት አስከፊ ጦርነት ወጥታ ወደ መደበኛ ህይወት ለመመለስ እያደረገች ያለውን ለውጥ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Heelikopteroonni waraana Siiriyaa magaalaa Damaasqoo keessatti ayyaana tokko irratti namoota walgahaniif roozii biifaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan waraana waggoota hedduu booda aadaa fi jireenya hawaasummaa deebisanii ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha. Gochi kun biyyattiin miidhaa waraana darbee booda gara tasgabbii fi jireenya idileetti deebi'uuf hawwii qabaachuu ishee ibsa.

title: Hamas leader heads to Cairo for Gaza talks ahead of Kushner visit
english: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya is traveling to Cairo to hold discussions with Egyptian intelligence officials regarding the ongoing Gaza conflict. This visit comes ahead of a planned Middle East trip by Jared Kushner, who aims to address a peace plan recently rejected by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Hamas continues to urge mediators to pressure Israel into accepting a ceasefire roadmap while military hostilities in Gaza persist.
amharic: የሃማስ ከፍተኛ መሪ ካሊል አል-ሃያ ስለ ጋዛ ቀውስ ለመወያየት ወደ ካይሮ ጉዞ አድርገዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ተወካይ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በክልሉ ከማድረጋቸው በፊት የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ ዓላማውም በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ውድቅ የተደረገውን የሰላም ዕቅድ ለማነጋገር ነው። ሃማስ አሜሪካ እና ሌሎች አሸማጋዮች እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን እንድትቀበል ጫና እንዲያደርጉ አሁንም እየጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Hamas, Khaliil al-Hayyaan, dhimma waraana Gaazaarratti mari'achuuf gara Kaayiroo imalaa jiru. Imalli kun kan ta'e, ergamaan Amerikaa Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa isaan duraan Pirezidaantii Israa'el Binyamiin Neetanyaahuun morman irratti mari'achuuf gara Baha Giddu-galeessaa dhufuuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Hamas gama isaatiin, waraanni Gaazaa keessatti itti fufuun isaa kan isaan yaaddessu ta'uu ibsuun, gama kanaan araara buusuuf dhiibbaan akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Talks on Hormuz Strait continue; Israel kills 11 in Lebanon
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated as Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon resulted in at least 11 deaths, marking the most significant violence since the June ceasefire. Meanwhile, Iranian officials are negotiating with Oman regarding security in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran stated that the full reopening of this vital shipping lane remains contingent on the United States honoring their previous agreement.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች መገደላቸው በሰኔ ወር ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ከፍተኛው ጥቃት ሆኗል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር የመርከብ እንቅስቃሴ ዙሪያ ከኦማን ጋር ውይይት እያደረገች ነው። ኢራን እንዳስታወቀችው ከሆነ፣ ይህንን የባህር መንገድ ሙሉ በሙሉ መክፈት የሚቻለው አሜሪካ ቀደም ሲል የተፈራረሙትን ስምምነት ስታከብር ብቻ ነው።
oromo: Isiraa'el kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa qilleensaan raawwatte kanaan namoonni 11 ol du'anii jiru; kunis waraana ji'a Waxabajjii dura dhaabbatee ture booda haleellaa hammaataa ta'e dha. Gama biraatiin, Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz irratti nageenya eeguuf biyya Oomaan waliin mari'achaa jirti. Iraan akka ibsiteratti, daandii galaana kana bakka duraatti deebisuun kan danda'amu yoo Ameerikaan walii galtee kanaan dura mallatteessite kabajje qofa dha.

title: Yemen’s government says Houthi strikes hit residential areas in Marib
english: The Yemeni government has condemned the Houthi group for launching a series of ballistic missiles and drone attacks against residential neighborhoods and displaced persons camps in Marib. These strikes have caused multiple injuries and significant property damage, further endangering the millions of people who have sought refuge in the city. This violence is part of a broader recent escalation in hostilities across the country that has resulted in numerous casualties on both sides.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት ሁቲዎች በመሪብ ከተማ በሚገኙ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እና ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ ካምፖች ላይ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና ድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አውግዟል። ይህ ጥቃት በከተማዋ ተጠልለው ለሚገኙ በሚሊዮን ለሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሕይወት ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ በሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ ንብረት እንዲወድም አድርጓል። ድርጊቱ በየመን እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት አካል ሲሆን በሁለቱም ወገኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen gareen Houtii magaalaa Maariib keessatti iddoowwan jireenyaa fi bakka buqqaattonni itti qubatan irratti weerara misaa'elaa fi dooniiwwan (drones) gaggeessuu isaa balaaleffateera. Weerarri kun namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawaman magaalaa sana keessa jiran irratti miidhaa guddaa kan qaqqabsiise yoo ta'u, qabeenyaa fi lubbuu irrattis miidhaan ga'eera. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa Yemen keessatti hammaachaa jiru keessaa isa tokko yoo ta'u, gartuuwwan lamaan irrattis lubbuun namoota hedduu darba jira.

title: At least five reported dead amid flooding in US state of Indiana
english: Severe storms and heavy rainfall over the past week have caused historic flooding in Indiana, resulting in at least five deaths. Rescue teams are actively working to save stranded residents as the state faces its worst flooding in over three decades. Governor Mike Braun has secured a commitment for federal emergency aid from the U.S. government to support ongoing recovery efforts.
amharic: ባለፈው ሳምንት በኢንዲያና ግዛት የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ እና የተከሰተው ጎርፍ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። ግዛቱ ከሰላሳ ዓመታት በላይ ባልታየ ደረጃ በከባድ ጎርፍ በመመታቱ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ተጎጂዎችን ለማውጣት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። የኢንዲያና ገዢ ማይክ ብራውን ከፌዴራል መንግስት ድንገተኛ የገንዘብ እና የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Torban darbe keessa naannoo Indiyaanaa keessatti rooba cimaa roobeen uumamee fi balaan lolaa lubbuu namoota shan galaafateera. Balaan lolaa kun waggoota soddoma darban keessatti kan hin mudanne waan ta'eef, hojjettoonni gargaarsaa namoota bishaan keessatti hafan oolchuuf tattaaffii bal'aa gochaa jiru. Gamtichi, mootummaan federaalaaa gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka godhuuf waadaa akka galeef gitaa biyyattii Maayik Biraawuniin beeksisaniiru.

title: Colombia asks Trump to suspend tariffs as country reels from earthquake
english: Following a devastating 7.4-magnitude earthquake that killed nearly 300 people and caused massive destruction, Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has requested that Donald Trump temporarily pause new U.S. tariffs. The country faces an estimated $6.4 billion reconstruction bill, and the leader hopes this trade relief will help local businesses recover. Despite a friendly relationship between the two presidents, the U.S. had previously imposed these tariffs on many trading partners due to concerns over labor policies.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በደረሰው የ7.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ወደ 300 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ፣ የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ ከአሜሪካው አቻቸው ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ውይይት አድርገዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ አገሪቱ ከምትገኝበት አስከፊ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ ለማገገም እና መልሶ ግንባታ ለማካሄድ 6.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልፀው፣ በአሜሪካ የተጣለባቸውን የታሪፍ ቀረጥ በጊዜያዊነት እንዲያነሱላቸው ጠይቀዋል። ቀደም ሲል አሜሪካ በሠራተኛ መብት አያያዝ ምክንያት በኮሎምቢያ ላይ የጣለችው የንግድ ቀረጥ፣ የአገሪቱን የመልሶ ግንባታ ጥረት እንደሚያስተጓጉል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti balaa socho'iinsa lafaa cimaa mudateen lubbuun namoota 300 ol erga darbee booda, pirezidaantiin biyyattii Abelardo de la Espriella, pirezidaant Doonaald Traampitti dhiheessuudhaan gibira daldalaa (tariffs) ameerikaan irra keesse akka haqu gaafataniiru. Biyyi kun deebisanii ijaaruuf qarshii biliyoona 6.4 kan barbaadu yoo ta'u, gibirri kun immoo diinagdee biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumaa jira. Pirezidaantichi dhimma kana irratti Traamp wajjin mari'atanii kan turan yoo ta'u, yeroo rakkoo cimaa kanaan biyyattii gargaaruuf gibirichi yeroof akka dhaabbatu gaafataniiru.

title: Report: Drone strikes kill three Houthi fighters and wound commanders in southwest Yemen
english: Yemeni government forces reported that a drone attack in the southwestern Taiz region resulted in the deaths of three Houthi fighters. The strikes also caused injuries to several other individuals, including key field commanders. This operation marks another incident of ongoing military conflict in the region.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በደቡብ ምዕራብ ታኢዝ ግዛት ባደረሱት የድሮን ጥቃት ሦስት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ ሌሎች ታጣቂዎችን እንዲሁም የቡድኑን የመስክ አዛዦች ማቁሰሉ ተገልጿል። ይህ ክስተት በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን የውትድርና ግጭት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen naannoo Ta’izitti miidhagaa kibba-dhihaatti xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeessaniin loltoonni Huutii sadan ajjeefamuu isaanii ibsameera. Haleellaa kanaan loltoota biroo fi ajajoonni waraana qondaalonni hedduun madaa’aniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa waraanaa naannichatti itti fufee jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians in Masafer Yatta attacks
english: Israeli settlers carried out a series of attacks against Palestinians in the Masafer Yatta region of the West Bank. Five individuals, including a child and two women, sustained injuries during an assault in the village of Umm al-Khair. Additionally, settlers caused damage to private property and a vehicle while traveling through nearby areas.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ማሳፈር ያታ አካባቢ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። በኡም አል-ኻይር መንደር በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ህጻን እና ሁለት ሴቶችን ጨምሮ አምስት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በተጨማሪም ሰፈራ ሰሪዎቹ በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች የሰዎችን ንብረት እና ተሽከርካሪ አውድመዋል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el naannoo Maasafer Yaataa kan jiruun Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa keessatti namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Magaalaa Umm al-Khair keessatti namoonni shan kanneen keessaa ijoolleen fi dubartoonni bakka bu'an miidhaan irra ga'eera. Kana malees, qotee bulaan kun qabeenya dhuunfaa fi konkolaataalee karaa irra turan irratti mancaatii geessisaniiru.

title: Why is the latest Ebola outbreak worsening?
english: A severe Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has resulted in 2,000 deaths. According to the World Health Organization, the virus is currently spreading more rapidly than in any prior incident, overwhelming existing control measures. Experts are working to identify the specific factors fueling this escalation and the associated public health risks.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ ሰሜናዊ ምስራቅ ክፍል የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እስካሁን 2,000 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት እንደገለጸው፣ ቫይረሱ ከቀድሞዎቹ ወረርሽኞች በበለጠ ፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ በመሆኑ የቁጥጥር ስራዎቹን እጅግ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ባለሙያዎች የበሽታውን መባባስ ምክንያቶች እና የሚያስከትለውን የጤና ስጋት ለመገምገም ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Koppa’uun dhibee Ebolaa kan kaaba-bahaa biyya Rippabiliika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti mudate namoota 2,000 ol ajjeeseera. Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa akka ibsetti, vaayirasichi kanaan dura irra saffisaan babal'achaa waan jiruuf, to'annoo godhamaa jiru caalaa ariifatee darba jira. Ogeeyyonni sababoota dhibee kanaa fi balaa fayyaa inni geessisu sakatta'uun furmaata barbaadaa jiru.

title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck the Indonesian island of Flores early Saturday, resulting in at least 47 deaths and significant destruction. Rescue teams are currently working to locate survivors among the rubble of hundreds of damaged homes and public buildings across remote, mountainous areas. The government is actively delivering emergency aid packages, though officials expect it will take time to fully understand the scope of the disaster due to the difficult terrain and ongoing aftershocks.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኢንዶኔዥያ ፍሎሬስ ደሴት ላይ የደረሰው የ7.7 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 47 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ከፍተኛ ውድመትም አስከትሏል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በከተሞች እና በገጠር አካባቢዎች የፈራረሱ ቤቶችንና ህንጻዎችን በመፈተሽ የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። መንግስት አስቸኳይ እርዳታዎችን ወደ አካባቢው እየላከ ቢሆንም፣ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የደረሰውን አጠቃላይ ጉዳት ለማጣራት አስቸጋሪ በሆነው የመሬት አቀማመጥ ምክንያት ጊዜ እንደሚወስድ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Dilbata ganama bahaa, buqee lafaa cimaan 7.7 magnitude qabu kutaalee Indoneezhiyaa keessa kan jirtu odoola Flores irratti mudatee lubbuun namoota 47 ol darbeera. Gareewwan fayyisootaafi gargaarsa namoomaa, gamoonniifi manneen hedduun caccabuu isaanii hordofee lubbuu namoota jiran barbaacha irratti argamu. Mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa erguu kan eegale yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan kutaalee sanaa tulluuwwan kan qabaniifi iddoo ulfaataa waan ta'aniif miidhaan guutuu inni geessise maal akka fakkaatu beekuuf yeroo fudhata jedhamee eegama.

title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
english: Iran has requested the release of three of its pilots, claiming they have been held by Qatar for six months following a combat mission during the ongoing war. Qatar has firmly denied these allegations, stating that the pilots are not in their custody and that they have already fulfilled their duties by searching for the airmen and returning the remains of a fourth pilot. Qatari officials maintain they acted in self-defense when the aircraft entered their airspace and have urged Iran to engage in official coordination regarding the rescue findings.
amharic: ኢራን በጦርነቱ ወቅት በአየር ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሶስት አብራሪዎቿ በኳታር ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል በማለት እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቃለች። ኳታር ይህንን ክስ አጥብቃ በመካድ አብራሪዎቹ በእጃቸው እንደሌሉ እና ቀደም ሲል የፍለጋ ስራ በማከናወን የአራተኛውን አብራሪ አስከሬን መመለሳቸውን አስታውቃለች። የኳታር መንግስት ድርጊታቸው የአገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት ለመከላከል የተወሰደ ህጋዊ እርምጃ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ኢራን በጉዳዩ ላይ በይፋዊ መንገድ እንድትወያይ ጠይቋል።
oromo: Iraan waraana ammaa keessatti xiyyaarri ishee lachuun rukutamanii, pilaayonni ishee sadii Qaxar harkatti akka qabaman ibsuun akka gadhiifaman gaafatteetti. Qaxar himata kana guutummaatti kan haalte yoo ta'u, pilaayonni kunneen harka isaanii akka hin jirre fi pilaayota arfaffaa du'e reeffa isaa kennuu isaanii ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Qaxar, tarkaanfiin fudhatame biyya isaanii of irraa ittisuuf kan fudhatame ta'uu fi Iraan gabaasa barbaacha isaa irratti marii akka taatu gaafatteetti.

title: Qatar denies it is detaining three Iranian bomber pilots
english: Qatar has officially rejected Iran’s allegations that it is secretly holding three Iranian pilots captured after their planes were shot down in March. While Iran claims the pilots are being detained without communication, Qatar insists that only the body of one deceased pilot was recovered and returned. Qatari officials stated these claims are misleading and emphasized that no surviving aircrew members are in their custody.
amharic: ኳታር በአውሮፕላኖቻቸው መመታትን ተከትሎ ሶስት የኢራን አብራሪዎችን በድብቅ ይዛለች የሚለውን የኢራን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። ኢራን አብራሪዎቹ በቁጥጥር ስር እንደሆኑ ብትገልጽም፣ ኳታር ግን የተገኘው የአንድ የሞተ አብራሪ አስከሬን ብቻ እንደሆነ እና ለኢራን እንደተረከበች አስታውቃለች። የኳታር ባለስልጣናት የኢራን መግለጫ ሀሰተኛ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ምንም አይነት ህያው አብራሪ በቁጥጥራቸው ስር እንደሌለ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Qatar himata Iran kan isheen qajeelatoota xiyyaaraa sadii qabattee hidheetti jirti jedhu haalteetti. Iran qajeelatoonni kun bakka hin beekamneetti hidhamanii jiru jechuun himattuus, Qatar garuu reeffa qajeelataa tokko qofa argachuu fi of eeggannoodhaan Iranitti deebisuu ishee ibsiteetti. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Qatar himanni kun dhugaa irraa fagaachuu isaa fi qajeelatoonni lubbuun jiran harka isaanii akka hin jirre mirkaneessaniiru.

title: California tackles multiple wildfires as firefighter workforce faces strain
english: California is struggling to control several large wildfires, including the significant Timber Fire in Big Sur and the massive Bug Fire near the Nevada border. These blazes have caused widespread evacuations and continue to spread due to hot, dry, and windy conditions. Meanwhile, firefighting crews are facing extreme pressure due to both the intensity of the climate-driven fires and recent federal budget cuts that have reduced their resources.
amharic: ካሊፎርኒያ በቢግ ሱር አካባቢ የተነሳውን የቲምበር እሳት እና በኔቫዳ ድንበር አቅራቢያ የሚገኘውን ትልቅ የቡግ እሳትን ጨምሮ በርካታ የዱር እሳቶችን ለመቆጣጠር እየታገለች ነው። እነዚህ የእሳት አደጋዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እንዲፈናቀሉ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በደረቅ እና ነፋሻማ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት እየተባባሱ ይገኛሉ። በሌላ በኩል፣ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ሠራተኞች በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት በሚባባሱ ትላልቅ እሳቶች እና በፌዴራል በጀት ቅነሳ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Kaalifoorniyaan ibidda bosonaa hedduu, kanneen akka ibidda 'Timber' naannoo Biig Sur fi ibidda guddaa 'Bug' daangaa Nivaadaa irratti argamu to'achuuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jirti. Ibiddoonni kun namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera, akkasumas haala qilleensa goginsaafi qilleensa cimaa kanaan walqabatee babal'achaa jiru. Gama biraatiin, hojjettoonni dhaamsuu ibiddaa jijjiirama qilleensaafi hanqina baajata mootummaa federaalaatiin walqabatee hojii baay'ee cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Canadian petition to expel US ambassador gains over 170,000 signatures
english: A Canadian petition calling for the expulsion of US Ambassador Pete Hoekstra has received over 170,000 signatures, far exceeding the requirement for a formal parliamentary review. Supporters claim Hoekstra has damaged diplomatic relations by making provocative statements and allegedly interfering in domestic politics. The petition demands that Canada officially declare the ambassador persona non grata and investigate the nature of US diplomatic conduct within the country.
amharic: የካናዳ የአሜሪካ አምባሳደር ፒት ሆክስትራ እንዲባረሩ የሚጠይቅ አቤቱታ ከ170,000 በላይ ፊርማዎችን በማሰባሰብ የፓርላማ ውይይት እንዲደረግበት የሚያስፈልገውን መስፈርት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አልፏል። አቤቱታ አቅራቢዎቹ አምባሳደሩ ተገቢ ያልሆኑ ንግግሮችን በመናገር እና በካናዳ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ጣልቃ በመግባት የሁለቱን አገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንደጎዱ ይከራከራሉ። አቤቱታው መንግስት አምባሳደሩን በአስቸኳይ እንዲያስወግድ እና በአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች የፖለቲካ ጣልቃ ገብነት ላይ ምርመራ እንዲያደርግ ይጠይቃል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Kaanaadaa jiraan, Piit Hookistaraan biyyattii gadhiisanii akka bahan kan gaafatu mallattoon ummataa 170,000 ol ta’e walitti qabameera. Namoonni mallatteessan kun, ambaasaaddarichi haasaa madaqina hin qabne dubbachuun fi dhimma keessoo biyyattii keessa galuun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii miidheera jedhu. Mallattoon kun mootummaan Kaanaadaa ambaasaaddaricha akka irratti tarkaanfii fudhatuu fi dhiibbaa Ameerikaan dhimma biyya keessaa irratti gootu qulqulleessuuf gaafata.

title: Moroccan Police Intercept Migrants Heading for Ceuta Enclave
english: Moroccan security forces have increased their presence in Fnideq to stop migrants from entering the Spanish territory of Ceuta. The deployment of additional personnel along the Tarajal border area has effectively prevented illegal crossings. Authorities have successfully restored order to the region following recent attempts by migrants to reach the enclave.
amharic: የሞሮኮ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ስደተኞች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ወደምትሆነው ሴውታ እንዳይገቡ ለመከላከል በፊንዴቅ አካባቢ ያላቸውን እንቅስቃሴ አጠናክረዋል። በታራጃል ድንበር አካባቢ የተሰማራው ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ኃይል ህገ-ወጥ የድንበር ማቋረጦችን በማስቆም በአካባቢው ሰላም እንዲሰፍን አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናቱ በቅርቡ ስደተኞች ወደ ግዛቷ ለመግባት ያደረጉትን ሙከራ በመቆጣጠር ሁኔታውን ወደ ቀድሞው ሰላማዊ ሁኔታ መልሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Morookoo godaantonni gara daangaa biyya Ispeen kan taate Se'utaatti akka hin ceene ittisuuf naannoo Fiindeqitti hojiiwwan isaanii cimsuudha. Humnoonni nageenyaa dabalataa daangaa Taaraajaal irratti bobba'an karaa seeraan alaa gara biyyattii seenuu barbaadan dhaabuun nagaa deebisaniiru. Bulchiinsi biyyattii yaalii godaantonni gara daangaa sanaatti ce'uuf godhan to'annoo jala oolchuu danda'aniiru.

title: Iran condemns Israeli attacks in Lebanon
english: Iran has officially denounced recent Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon that resulted in the deaths of 11 people, including children. A government spokesperson criticized the United Nations for failing to intervene against these violations of international law. Tehran expressed strong support for Lebanon's sovereignty following these incidents, which represent the most severe violence since a ceasefire framework was established in June.
amharic: ኢራን በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ 11 ሰዎችን የገደለውን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በጽኑ አውግዛለች። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት በህገ-ወጥ ድርጊቱ ላይ ዝምታ መምረጡን ነቅፈዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ባለፈው ሰኔ ወር ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ እጅግ አሳሳቢው መሆኑ የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ኢራንም የሊባኖስን ሉዓላዊነት እንደምትደግፍ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Iraan, kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa xiyyaaraan Israa'el raawwatteefi daa'imman dabalatee namoota 11 ajjeese kana balaaleffatteetti. Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniifi mana maree nageenyaa isaanii badii kana irratti callisuu isaaniitiin qeequu isaanii ibsameera. Haleellaan kun guyyaa ji'a Waxabajjii irraa jalqabee walii galtee waraana dhaabuu booda kan raawwatameefi yeroo hunda caalaa kan cimaa dhufe yoo ta'u, Iraanis bilisummaa Libaanoos cinaa dhaabbachuu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: Moroccan police arrest over 100 migrants trying to reach Spanish enclave
english: Moroccan security forces have apprehended over 100 individuals attempting to enter the Spanish territory of Ceuta. These crowds were reportedly mobilized by a deceptive social media campaign encouraging migration through dangerous mountainous routes. Authorities used tear gas to manage the situation as tensions remain high following a previous mass migration event in the region.
amharic: የሞሮኮ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሱዌታ ለመግባት የሞከሩ ከ100 በላይ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እነዚህ ሰዎች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በተሰራጨ የተሳሳተ መረጃ ተገፋፍተው በአደገኛ የተራራ መንገድ ለመጓዝ ሞክረዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ህዝቡን ለመበተን የለቅሶ ጋዝ የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን፣ አካባቢው ባለፈው ወር በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የፍልሰት እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Morookoo namoota 100 ol kan ta'an gara daangaa Ispeen Se'uta (Ceuta) seenuuf yaalanii turan to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Namoonni kunneen duula odeeffannoo sobaa miidiyaalee hawaasaarratti gaggeeffameen kaka'anii karaa gaarreenii fi miidhaa guddaa qabuun daangaa ce'uuf yaalan. Bulchiinsi biyyattii walitti qamama kana bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaansuu kan fayyadaman yoo ta'u, kanaan dura godaansi guddaan mudachuu isaatiin wal-qabatee naannichi amma ammayyuu tasgabbii dhabee jira.

title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
english: Liechtenstein has updated its royal succession laws to enable women to inherit the throne, moving from a male-only priority system to one based on birth order regardless of gender. This amendment will apply to the descendants of Hereditary Prince Alois's children rather than the current line of succession. The royal family stated that this shift aims to ensure that future leaders are chosen based on their qualifications for the role.
amharic: የሊችተንስታይን ንጉሳዊ ቤተሰብ ሴቶች የዙፋኑ ወራሽ እንዲሆኑ የሚያስችል አዲስ ህግ አስተዋውቋል። ከዚህ በኋላ የሚደረገው የዙፋን ውርስ የልጆችን የትውልድ ቅደም ተከተል ብቻ መሰረት የሚያደርግ ይሆናል። ይህ ለውጥ አሁን ያለውን የዙፋን ቅደም ተከተል የማይነካ ሲሆን፣ ከወራሹ ልጆች ለሚወለዱት ተተኪዎች ብቻ ተግባራዊ የሚሆን ነው።
oromo: Biyyi Liichtenstaayin jedhamtu seera itti fayyadama aangoo mootummaa ishee kan yeroo durii dhiiraaf qofa ta’e geeddaruun dubartoonnis akka mooti ta’uu danda’an taasisteetti. Haaraa kanaan, ijoolleen hangafni saalaan osoo hin hiraminiif bakka bu’uuf mirga qabaatu. Jijjiiramni kun gara fuulduraatti ijoollee ilmi mootichaa Aloos argatan irratti kan hojii irra oolu ta’ee, kaayyoon isaas namni madaalawaa ta’e akka biyya bulchuufi.

title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta
english: Moroccan security forces detained over 100 migrants near the border town of Fnideq as they attempted to enter the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. Authorities heavily reinforced the area with troops, drones, and naval vessels following viral social media posts that encouraged a mass crossing attempt. This operation follows a recent surge in migration activity that has heightened security and diplomatic tensions in the region.
amharic: የሞሮኮ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ለመግባት የሞከሩ ከ100 በላይ ስደተኞችን በድንበር አካባቢ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በሶሻል ሚዲያ በተሰራጩ ጥሪዎች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ሰዎች ድንበር ለመሻገር መሞከራቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን በወታደሮች፣ በድሮኖች እና በባህር ኃይል አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በቅርቡ በተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት በክልሉ የተፈጠረውን የጸጥታ ውጥረት ተከትሎ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Morookkoo godaantota 100 ol ta'an kanneen gara daangaa Ispeen Se'utaatti ce'uuf yaalii godhan naannoo Fnideqitti to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Namoonni hedduun miidiyaa hawaasaarratti waamicha godhame hordofuudhaan daangaa ce'uuf yaaluun isaanii erga beekamee booda, mootummaan humna waraanaa, dooniiwwan waraanaa fi dirooniin daangichaa akka jabaatu godheera. Tarkaanfiin kun godaantota hedduu daangaa ce'uuf yaalaniin walqabatee rakkoon nageenyaa fi siyaasaa naannichatti uumame kan itti fufe dha.

title: Death toll from Zimbabwe ferry disaster rises to 69
english: The death toll from a ferry sinking on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has climbed to 69 after 23 additional bodies were recovered. Authorities believe the vessel, which was carrying over 150 people despite an official limit of 90, overturned due to severe weather and overloading. The government has declared a national disaster, as the tragedy has devastated local communities that relied on the ferry for essential supplies.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ የሰመጠው የጀልባ አደጋ ሰለባዎች ቁጥር ተጨማሪ 23 አስከሬኖች በመገኘታቸው ወደ 69 ከፍ ብሏል። 90 ሰው የመጫን አቅም ብቻ የነበራት ጀልባ ከ150 በላይ ሰዎችን ጭና በመጓዟ እና በጠንካራ ንፋስ ምክንያት እንደገለበጠች ተጠቁሟል። መንግሥት አደጋውን ብሔራዊ የጥፋት ቀናት በማለት አውጆ፣ በአካባቢው ለሚገኙ ማህበረሰቦች አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Zimbaabwee keessatti markabni haroo Kaariibaa keessatti gubate kun lubbuu namoota 69 galaafateera. Markabichi namoota 90 qofa fe'uu kan danda'u ta'us, namoota 150 ol fe'ee imala isaa jalqabuun isaa fi bubbeen cimaan mudachuu isaatiin ajaja isaa akka dhabe ibsameera. Mootummaan balaa kana akka balaa biyyoolessaatti kan labse yoo ta'u, uummata miidhameef gargaarsa gochuuf duula eegaleera.

title: Qatar denies detaining Iranian pilots, says it found remains of one

title: Israel says soldiers wounded in southern Lebanon
english: Three Israeli soldiers, including an officer, were injured following a drone explosion in southern Lebanon during the night. The military confirmed that the wounded personnel have been evacuated to a hospital for medical care. The soldiers' families have already been informed of the incident.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተከሰተ የድሮን ጥቃት አንድ መኮንንን ጨምሮ ሶስት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ቆሰሉ። ወታደሮቹ ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል የተወሰዱ ሲሆን የቤተሰቦቻቸውም መረጃ እንደደረሳቸው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ገልጿል።
oromo: Halkan darbue kibba Libaanoositti weerara xiyyaara nama malee (drone) kanaan loltoonni Israa'el saddeet, isaan keessaa ajajaan tokko, miidhamaniiru. Loltoonni miidhaman kun yaalaaf gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru akkasumas maatiin isaanii waa'ee haalicha akka beekan ta'eera.

title: La Liga: Real Madrid key talking points heading into new 2026-27 season
english: Real Madrid has reappointed Jose Mourinho as head coach following two seasons without a major trophy. The team has significantly bolstered its defensive roster with new signings while retaining star offensive players like Kylian Mbappe and Jude Bellingham. The club aims to regain its dominant position in La Liga and the Champions League, hoping Mourinho’s disciplined approach can prevent rival Barcelona from winning a third consecutive league title.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ ምንም አይነት ዋንጫ ሳይበላ ሁለት ዓመታት ካሳለፈ በኋላ ሆዜ ሞሪንሆ በአሰልጣኝነት እንዲመለሱ አድርጓል። ክለቡ የተከላካይ መስመሩን ለማጠናከር አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን የጨመረ ሲሆን እንደ ካይሊያን ምባፔ እና ጁድ ቤሊንግሃም ያሉ ኮከብ አጥቂዎችንም ይዞ ቀጥሏል። ማድሪድ በላ ሊጋ እና በሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የበላይነቱን ለመመለስ የሚፈልግ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም ባርሴሎና ሶስተኛ የሊግ ዋንጫውን እንዳያገኝ የሞሪንሆ ተግሣጽ የተሞላበት የጨዋታ ስልት ይረዳቸዋል ተብሎ ይታመናል።
oromo: Real Madrid waggoota lama waancaa malee dabarsuun booda Jose Mourinho gara leenjistummaa akka deebi'an taasiseera. Gareen kun ittisa isaanii cimsuuf taphattoota haaraa kan filatan yoo ta'u, taphattoota olaanoo akka Kylian Mbappe fi Jude Bellingham waliin itti fufuuf murteessaniiru. Real Madrid dorgommii La Liga fi Champions League irratti injifannoo argachuuf kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, mala Mourinho kan cimina irratti xiyyeeffatuun Barcelona waancaa sadaffaa akka hin fudhanne dhaabuuf yaadameera.
